provenanceNote: From the 6-7 Nov real-model run (F-16a). The reports quote each refusal's field and the matched words (for example: the story says "Many people"; insight 5 says "most of "), not the whole sentence: the replies are in that run's eval database and were never copied into the repository. So each sentence below is a reconstruction written around the quoted words, and the reply is built around the first of them so that only the quantity check is in question. The objective is the eval's Quillmoor sign-ups one, where four of the six refusals happened. Simulated data: the demo brand and its customers are generated.
